EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: 3/ ඉ/අƮපƮ//11/ෙවʚම/ෙබʤයවලාන.

Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/7/2016/HW/63. I do hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the State intends to acquire the following lands which is required for a Public Purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Twelve lots in total extent of 4.4911 Hectares, as depicted in final village Plan No. 449, supplementary sheet No. 26/sheet No. 28 of 20.10.2016 prepared by the senior superintendent of surveys on behalf of surveyor General, situated in the village of Boyawalana in Grama Niladari Division No. 1029 Boyawalana in divisional Secretary’s Division of Alawwa in Kurunegala District, North Western Province, further described as follows: 1. Lot No. 276 Name of the Land: Eastern Estate or Maedandamankadahena or Palamagawahena or N a wa t e h e n a or M e d a wi a m un a h en a or Mahakongahamulahena or Ambagahamulahena or Amunekumburuyaya; Description: Garden and mixed plantation; Claiment: State; Original Claiment: Sarala Athulathmudali, Eastern Estate, Boyawalana, Keppitiwelana; Extent: 1.9268 Hectares.

2. Lot No. 277 Name of the Land: Eastern Estate or Maedandamankadahena or Palamagawahena or Amunekumburuyaya; Description: Paddy Field; Claimant: State; Original Claiment: Sarala Athulathmudali, Eastern Estate, Boyawalana, Keppitiwelana; Extent: 1.7568 Hectares.

All Persons whom interested in the aforesaid lands, There names are in the Gazette notice or not are requested to submit their claims in writing, the nature of their claims for compensation, on the day of 25.11.2016 to me at my office.

Since all persons who submit their claims may call for an inquiry. The dates of inquiry will informed individually to each claimant. On the due date claimant or his/her agent duly authorized by the claimant in writing should presented the inquiry and submit their claims by deeds and other documents informed by me. In addition to said documents the amount of the compensation and details of the compensation should submit in two copies. If an agent present at the inquiry, he/she should submit a duly authorized letter from the original claimant without such a letter any statement or evidence will not be recorded at the inquiry. P. SUSANTHA JAYATHILAKA, Divisional Secretary and Land acquisition officer, Alawwa. Divisional Secretariat, Alawwa, 27th October 2016. 11 - 966
